When k \neq 0, the distance from the circle center to line l: kx - y + 1 = 0 is d = \frac{1}{\sqrt{k^2+1}}, so |MN| = 2\sqrt{4-\frac{1}{k^2+1}}.
Also with y = -\frac{1}{k}x+1, similarly |PQ| = 2\sqrt{4-\frac{k^2}{k^2+1}} = 2\sqrt{3+\frac{1}{k^2+1}}.
